name: MsoDocInspectorStatus
description: Represents the results of running a Document Inspector module.

constants.name: msoDocInspectorStatusDocOk
constants.description: Indicates that the Document Inspector module returned no issues or errors.

constants.name: msoDocInspectorStatusIssueFound
constants.description: Indicates that the Document Inspector module found one or more occurrences of the search criteria.

constants.name: msoDocInspectorStatusError
constants.description: Indicates that the Document Inspector module returned an error.
